example_sentences_in_english: His office is located in the main market of the city.
In olden days, merchants used to sit in their establishments and keep accounts.
history: Refers to traditional Bengali mercantile setups in urban bazaars during colonial and pre-colonial eras, where 'gadi' symbolized the seat of business authority.
note: This term is more archaic and commonly used in literary or historical contexts referring to traditional shops.
